distribution.narrative: Yang (2020) explicitly lists Yunnan and Hainan and is accepted as specialist-checklist evidence for mainland-China occurrence. The separate historical Taiwan record under Cryphalus scabricollis remains Questionable because Beaver & Liu (2010) regarded that imported-timber record as unconfirmed.

host_note: No host evidence is reported for this doubtful Taiwan record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus discretus Eichhoff, 1878.
